how.description: Explain a system mechanism, call chain, data ownership, or module boundary from source.

why.description: Trace the historical reasons for a code or design decision using commits and records.

architect.description: Design module boundaries, core types, and interfaces from caller usage for substantial architecture decisions.

arena.description: Compare isolated candidates for the same design or code problem and synthesize a verified result.

swarm.description: Delegate independent investigation or execution slices with isolated outputs and verified coverage.

interrogate.description: Challenge a disputed design with independent counterexamples and executable checks.

blast-radius.description: Trace a change beyond its diff and test the assumptions on which its safety depends.

figure-it-out.description: Plan and execute a complex multi-stage task with falsifiable completion criteria and evidence.

poteto-mode.description: Choose an appropriate pstack workflow for the current task without making heavy flows mandatory.

setup-pstack.description: Inspect host and project capabilities and configure bounded pstack roles and concurrency.

tdd.description: Fix a bug through an observed failing check followed by a passing regression.

create-verification-skill.description: Create a project skill that can launch, operate, capture evidence, and clean up a real feature.

maintain-verification-skill.description: Repair an existing project verification skill using observed product behavior.

recall.description: Recover decisions and unfinished work from explicitly scoped task records.

reflect.description: Review scoped task history for repeated mistakes and evidence-backed process improvements.

automate-me.description: Derive a reusable personal work mode from authorized conversation samples with independent evidence.

show-me-your-work.description: Keep a reviewable decision log and actual evidence for multi-round work.

no-comments.description: Replace redundant code narration with clearer code while preserving valuable rationale and directives.

unslop.description: Edit prose for clarity and concision while preserving facts and uncertainty.

bro.description: Restate the previous explanation in simpler language without adding facts.

technical-writing.description: Write technical documentation or PR descriptions grounded in actual interfaces and checks.

make-bot-ui.description: Design or implement a bot UI against real state and messaging interfaces.

teach.description: Explain what a subsystem is, how it works, and why it exists at the user’s pace.

typescript-best-practices.description: Apply TypeScript type and boundary practices to a concrete implementation.
